rows.note: Use this for medical separation of someone with a contagious illness from other people.

example.english: Patients with contagious diseases need isolation and cannot contact other people.
example.traditional: 有傳染病嘅病人要隔離，唔可以同其他人接觸。
example.jyutping: jau5 cyun4 jim5 beng6 ge3 beng6 jan4 jiu3 gaak3 lei4 m4 ho2 ji5 tung4 kei4 taa1 jan4 zip3 cuk1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for spending time alone or being apart from other people without stressing loneliness.

example.english: I like some isolation after work and enjoy reading quietly.
example.traditional: 我放工之後鍾意獨處一陣，靜靜哋睇書。
example.jyutping: ngo5 fong3 gung1 zi1 hau6 zung1 ji3 duk6 cyu5 jat1 zan6 zing6 zing6 dei6 tai2 syu1

rows.note: Choose this slice when the isolation emphasizes loneliness or emotional suffering rather than simply being alone.

example.english: Long-term isolation can make people feel very lonely.
example.traditional: 長期冇人陪，會令人覺得好孤獨。
example.jyutping: coeng4 kei4 mou5 jan4 pui4 wui5 ling6 jan4 gok3 dak1 hou2 gu1 duk6
